title: Keep local, VCS and file sources in pylock.toml

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,3 @@
+Keep path, editable, VCS and file dependencies in ``pylock.toml`` as PEP 751 ``directory``, ``vcs`` and ``archive``
+sources, and install them from those sources. Previously they were written as plain index packages, so installing
+from ``pylock.toml`` looked the name up on the package index.

         return lockfile
 
 
+VCS_TYPES = ("git", "hg", "svn", "bzr")
+ARCHIVE_SUFFIXES = (".whl", ".zip", ".tar.gz", ".tgz", ".tar.bz2", ".tar.xz", ".tar")
+
+
+def _pylock_source_from_lockfile_entry(package_data: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    """Map a Pipfile.lock path, VCS or file entry to PEP 751 package fields."""
+    vcs_type = next((vcs for vcs in VCS_TYPES if vcs in package_data), None)
+    if vcs_type:
+        vcs = {"type": vcs_type, "url": package_data[vcs_type]}
+        if package_data.get("ref"):
+            vcs["commit-id"] = package_data["ref"]
+        if package_data.get("subdirectory"):
+            vcs["subdirectory"] = package_data["subdirectory"]
+        return {"vcs": vcs}
+
+    if "path" not in package_data and "file" not in package_data:
+        return {}
+
+    location = package_data.get("path") or package_data.get("file")
+    if "file" in package_data or location.lower().endswith(ARCHIVE_SUFFIXES):
+        archive = {"path" if "path" in package_data else "url": location}
+        hashes = {
+            algorithm: digest
+            for algorithm, _, digest in (
+                value.partition(":") for value in package_data.get("hashes", [])
+            )
+            if digest
+        }
+        if hashes:
+            archive["hashes"] = hashes
+        return {"archive": archive}
+
+    directory = {"path": location}
+    if package_data.get("editable"):
+        directory["editable"] = True
+    if package_data.get("subdirectory"):
+        directory["subdirectory"] = package_data["subdirectory"]
+    return {"directory": directory}
+
+
+def _lockfile_path(path: str) -> str:
+    """Return a pylock.toml path in the form Pipfile.lock uses for local paths.
+
+    PEP 751 writes relative paths as plain ``localpkg``, which pipenv would
+    read as a package name, so relative paths get a leading ``./``.
+    """
+    if Path(path).is_absolute() or path.startswith(("./", "../", ".\\", "..\\")):
+        return path
+    return f"./{path}"
+
+
+def _lockfile_source_from_pylock_package(package: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    """Map PEP 751 directory, VCS and archive fields to a Pipfile.lock entry."""
+    if "vcs" in package:
+        vcs = package["vcs"]
+        entry = {vcs["type"]: vcs.get("url") or vcs.get("path")}
+        ref = vcs.get("commit-id") or vcs.get("requested-revision")
+        if ref:
+            entry["ref"] = ref
+        if vcs.get("subdirectory"):
+            entry["subdirectory"] = vcs["subdirectory"]
+        return entry
+
+    if "directory" in package:
+        directory = package["directory"]
+        entry = {"path": _lockfile_path(directory["path"])}
+        if directory.get("editable"):
+            entry = {"editable": True, **entry}
+        if directory.get("subdirectory"):
+            entry["subdirectory"] = directory["subdirectory"]
+        return entry
+
+    if "archive" in package:
+        archive = package["archive"]
+        entry = (
+            {"file": archive["url"]}
+            if "url" in archive
+            else {"path": _lockfile_path(archive["path"])}
+        )
+        if archive.get("hashes"):
+            entry["hashes"] = [
+                f"{algorithm}:{digest}" for algorithm, digest in archive["hashes"].items()
+            ]
+        return entry
+
+    return {}
+
+

@@ -0,0 +1,94 @@
+import json
+
+import pytest
+
+from pipenv.utils.pylock import PylockFile
+
+LOCAL_ENTRIES = {
+    "localpkg": {"path": "./localpkg"},
+    "editablepkg": {"editable": True, "path": "./editablepkg"},
+    "gitpkg": {
+        "git": "https://github.com/example/gitpkg.git",
+        "ref": "4f2a9c1e7b3d5a8f0c6e2b9d1a7f3c5e8b0d2a4f",
+    },
+    "archivepkg": {
+        "file": "https://example.com/archivepkg-1.0.tar.gz",
+        "hashes": ["sha256:" + "a" * 64],
+    },
+}
+
+
+def _pylock_from_lockfile(tmp_path, default):
+    lockfile_path = tmp_path / "Pipfile.lock"
+    lockfile_path.write_text(
+        json.dumps(
+            {
+                "_meta": {
+                    "sources": [
+                        {"name": "pypi", "url": "https://pypi.org/simple", "verify_ssl": True}
+                    ],
+                    "requires": {},
+                },
+                "default": default,
+                "develop": {},
+            }
+        )
+    )
+    return PylockFile.from_lockfile(lockfile_path)
+
+
+def _package(pylock, name):
+    return next(package for package in pylock.packages if package["name"] == name)
+
+
+def test_from_lockfile_keeps_local_and_vcs_sources(tmp_path):
+    pylock = _pylock_from_lockfile(tmp_path, LOCAL_ENTRIES)
+
+    assert _package(pylock, "localpkg")["directory"] == {"path": "./localpkg"}
+    assert _package(pylock, "editablepkg")["directory"] == {
+        "path": "./editablepkg",
+        "editable": True,
+    }
+    assert _package(pylock, "gitpkg")["vcs"] == {
+        "type": "git",
+        "url": "https://github.com/example/gitpkg.git",
+        "commit-id": "4f2a9c1e7b3d5a8f0c6e2b9d1a7f3c5e8b0d2a4f",
+    }
+    assert _package(pylock, "archivepkg")["archive"] == {
+        "url": "https://example.com/archivepkg-1.0.tar.gz",
+        "hashes": {"sha256": "a" * 64},
+    }
+    # These packages don't come from the index, so they get no index or wheels
+    for name in LOCAL_ENTRIES:
+        assert "index" not in _package(pylock, name)
+        assert "wheels" not in _package(pylock, name)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("name", list(LOCAL_ENTRIES))
+def test_local_and_vcs_sources_round_trip_to_pipfile_lock(tmp_path, name):
+    pylock = _pylock_from_lockfile(tmp_path, {name: LOCAL_ENTRIES[name]})
+    pylock.write()
+
+    lockfile = PylockFile.from_path(pylock.path).convert_to_pipenv_lockfile()
+
+    expected = {key: value for key, value in LOCAL_ENTRIES[name].items() if key != "hashes"}
+    entry = lockfile["default"][name]
+    assert {key: value for key, value in entry.items() if key != "hashes"} == expected
+    assert "version" not in entry
+
+
+def test_convert_directory_package_from_another_tool(tmp_path):
+    path = tmp_path / "pylock.toml"
+    path.write_text(
+        "lock-version = '1.0'\n"
+        "created-by = 'test-tool'\n"
+        "[[packages]]\n"
+        "name = 'localpkg'\n"
+        "version = '0.1.0'\n"
+        "directory = { path = 'localpkg', editable = false }\n"
+    )
+
+    lockfile = PylockFile.from_path(path).convert_to_pipenv_lockfile()
+
+    # A bare relative path would be read as a package name, so it gets "./"
+    assert lockfile["default"]["localpkg"] == {"path": "./localpkg"}
